bios.13: Shino Aburame is a calm, analytical Aburame who hosts a colony of kikaichu insects inside his body. A member of Team Kurenai, he serves as a tracker and sensor. His dry wit shows through his shades.
bios.40: Choji Akimichi is a gentle Akimichi who can enlarge his body with the clan's Expansion Jutsu. A loyal friend and member of Team Asuma, he turns his fear into determination. His secret pill risks his life for his friends.
bios.193: Deidara is an explosive Akatsuki artist who believes true art is a fleeting bang. A former Iwagakure bomber, he uses clay with mouths in his palms. His rivalry with Sasuke ends in a legendary final explosion.
bios.259: Gaara of the Desert is the jinchuriki of the One-Tail and the Fifth Kazekage of Sunagakure. Once a lonely, murderous child, he is redeemed through his bond with Naruto. In Shippuden he leads his village with quiet strength.
bios.293: Hayate Gekko was a chunin exam proctor and a swordsman of Konoha, known for his persistent cough. He discovers Orochimaru's invasion plan and is killed by Baki. His Moonlight sword style lingers in memory.
bios.344: Might Guy, the Konoha's Noble Blue Beast, is an elite taijutsu master and Kakashi's eternal rival. He believes in hard work above talent and leads Team Guy with fiery passion. His Eight Inner Gates technique pushes him beyond human limits.
bios.356: Haku is Zabuza's loyal apprentice who wields the Ice Release kekkei genkai. Gentle in spirit, he sees himself as a tool for his master. His fate leaves a mark on Naruto and Sasuke.
bios.374: Sakura Haruno is a Team 7 kunoichi who grows from a bookish genin into a peerless medical ninja. Trained by Tsunade, she combines surgical chakra control with monstrous strength. She is the heart of Team Kakashi and a decisive force in the war.
bios.376: Kakashi Hatake is the Copy Ninja of the Hidden Leaf, famed for the Sharingan in his left eye and over a thousand copied jutsu. As leader of Team 7 he teaches teamwork above all, haunted by the comrades he has lost. He later serves as the Sixth Hokage.
bios.388: Hidan is an immortal Jashin follower in the Akatsuki who battles by rituals and sacrifices. Teamed with Kakuzu, his foul mouth and unkillable body make him a nightmare for Konoha. He is finally buried alive by Shikamaru.
bios.421: Kisame Hoshigaki, the Tailless Tailed Beast, is a former Mist swordsman and Itachi's Akatsuki partner. He wields the sentient sword Samehada and enormous water chakra. His loyalty to Itachi never wavers.
bios.437: Hinata Hyuga is the gentle heiress of the Hyuga clan who has admired Naruto since childhood. Her Byakugan and Gentle Fist make her a formidable support fighter. Her courage on the battlefield proves that kindness can be a strength.
bios.444: Neji Hyuga is a Hyuga prodigy who struggles against the clan's caged-bird seal and the fate it represents. He overcomes his resentment thanks to Naruto and becomes a guardian of his friends. His sacrifice in the war is one of the most moving in the series.
bios.466: Kiba Inuzuka is a rowdy Inuzuka clan ninja who fights beside his ninken Akamaru. A tracking expert with sharp senses, he leads Team Kurenai. His loyal spirit makes him a good friend.
bios.515: Jiraiya the Gallant is one of the legendary Sannin, a toad sage and spymaster who wrote the Icha Icha novels. As Naruto's master he teaches the Rasengan and Sage Mode. His investigation of the Akatsuki leader costs him his life in Amegakure.
bios.558: Kakuzu is a bounty-obsessed Akatsuki member who extends his life by stealing hearts. His five hearts give him five elemental masks and nearly endless stamina. He falls to Naruto's Wind Release: Rasenshuriken.
bios.577: Kankuro is Gaara's brother and a puppet master from Sunagakure. He controls Karasu, Kuroari and Sanshouo with poison and traps. He is protective of his siblings and loyal to Suna.
bios.636: Killer B is the eight-tails jinchuriki of Kumogakure and the Raikage's brother. A rapping, sword-wielding hotshot, he has total control over his Gyuki. He becomes a mentor and friend to Naruto.
bios.684: Konan is a paper-wielding Akatsuki member and Nagato's lifelong friend. She helps found Amegakure's resistance and remains loyal to Nagato until his death. Her origami-based jutsu is as beautiful as it is deadly.
bios.739: Rock Lee is a taijutsu specialist who cannot use ninjutsu or genjutsu yet works tirelessly to become a splendid ninja. A student of Might Guy, he unlocks the Eight Gates to defy fate. His spirit inspires everyone around him.
bios.831: Zabuza Momochi is the Demon of the Hidden Mist, a missing-nin who wields the Executioner's Blade. He battles Team 7 in the Land of Waves alongside Haku. His last words show a hidden humanity.
bios.861: Nagato is the Rinnegan-wielding leader of the Akatsuki and the real man behind the Six Paths of Pain. Orphaned by war, he and his friends dreamt of peace through suffering. Naruto's words convince him to end his path and revive Konoha.
bios.865: Minato Namikaze, the Yellow Flash of the Leaf, was the Fourth Hokage and master of the Flying Thunder God. He sealed half of the Nine-Tails into his infant son Naruto at the cost of his life. His legacy echoes through his students and his son.
bios.878: Shikamaru Nara is a lazy genius with an IQ over 200 and mastery of the Shadow Possession Jutsu. He rises from chunin to Naruto's strategist and chief advisor. His tactical mind turns the tide of many battles.
bios.925: Onoki is the Third Tsuchikage of Iwagakure, a stubborn old man who can weigh and disintegrate his enemies with Dust Release. He fights in the Fourth Great Ninja War despite his age. He eventually accepts the next generation.
bios.928: Orochimaru is a rogue Sannin obsessed with immortality and mastery of every jutsu. He founds Otogakure, experiments on shinobi and hunts for Sasuke's body. His cunning and curse seals leave a long shadow across the series.
bios.940: Kaguya Otsutsuki is the Rabbit Goddess who ate the chakra fruit and gave birth to the Six Paths Sage. She is the mother of chakra and becomes the final enemy of the Great Ninja War. Sealed away, she is left to Team 7's power.
bios.1034: Asuma Sarutobi is the son of the Third Hokage and a Guardian Ninja of the Fire Daimyo. A chain-smoking jonin, he leads Team 10 and teaches the value of friendship. He is killed by Hidan.
bios.1036: Hiruzen Sarutobi, the Professor, is the Third Hokage and a master of all five chakra natures. He guided Konoha through two wars and trained the Sannin. His life ends defending the village from Orochimaru.
bios.1037: Konohamaru Sarutobi is the grandson of the Third Hokage and Naruto's self-proclaimed rival. He masters the Rasengan under Naruto's guidance and grows into a true ninja. He dreams of becoming Hokage.
bios.1042: Sasori of the Red Sand is a puppet master from Sunagakure who turned himself into a living puppet. In the Akatsuki he partners with Deidara and collects human puppets. He is defeated by Sakura and Chiyo.
bios.1063: Hashirama Senju, the God of Shinobi, is the First Hokage and founder of Konoha. His Wood Release can tame tailed beasts and raise forests in an instant. He dreamed of a village where children no longer had to fight.
bios.1066: Tobirama Senju is the Second Hokage, Hashirama's brother and the inventor of the Flying Thunder God and Edo Tensei. A strict, brilliant strategist, he created many of Konoha's institutions. He was killed protecting his men from Kumo ninja.
bios.1093: Danzo Shimura is the head of Root and a ruthless Konoha elder who believes secrecy protects the village. He wields stolen Sharingan and Wood Release. His methods place him at odds with Sasuke and Naruto.
bios.1208: Temari of the Hidden Sand is Gaara's elder sister and a wind-style specialist who wields a giant fan. She represents Suna in the Chunin Exams and in the war. Her cool head keeps her brothers in line.
bios.1216: Tenten is a weapons specialist of Team Guy who can wield hundreds of tools in a single fight. Her sealing scroll rains kunai and shuriken from above. She fights alongside Lee and Neji.
bios.1280: Tsunade is the Fifth Hokage, a legendary Sannin and the greatest medical ninja the world has seen. Granddaughter of the First Hokage, she is known for her enormous strength and an unlucky streak at gambling. She guides Konoha through the Akatsuki crisis.
bios.1293: Itachi Uchiha was a prodigy of Konoha who shouldered the darkest secret in the village: the order to end his own clan. He joined the Akatsuki as a double agent, quietly protecting Sasuke until the end. His final act shaped the destiny of both brothers.
bios.1299: Madara Uchiha was the co-founder of Konoha and the most feared shinobi of his age. After a break with Hashirama he sought a world of endless dream through the Infinite Tsukuyomi. Revived in the Fourth Great Ninja War, he stands as a nearly unbeatable foe.
bios.1303: Obito Uchiha was a once-cheerful Team Minato member who lost his faith after the death of Rin. As the masked man Tobi he orchestrates the Akatsuki and the Fourth Great Ninja War. In the end he finds redemption by helping Naruto.
bios.1307: Sasuke Uchiha is the last loyal survivor of his clan, driven by a vow to avenge its massacre. His quest for power leads him from Konoha to Orochimaru and into the heart of the Uchiha tragedy. He eventually fights beside Naruto and chooses to atone by watching over the world from the shadows.
bios.1325: Iruka Umino is the Academy teacher who first recognised Naruto's worth. He treats Naruto like a younger brother and encourages him to keep going. His kind guidance shapes the next generation of shinobi.
bios.1337: Yugao Uzuki is a Konoha ANBU captain with a cat mask and a talent for kenjutsu. She is Hayate's lover and serves on Kakashi's missions. She stands guard over Konoha from the shadows.
bios.1341: Kushina Uzumaki, the Red Hot-Blooded Habanero, was Naruto's mother and the second jinchuriki of the Nine-Tails. Fiery and warm, she was Minato's wife and the pride of the Uzumaki clan. She spends her final moments sharing her love with her son.
bios.1344: Naruto Uzumaki is the loud, stubborn jinchuriki of the Nine-Tails who dreams of becoming Hokage. Shunned as a child, he earns the respect of the village through sheer determination and the bonds he forges. In Shippuden he masters Sage Mode, ends the Fourth Great Ninja War and finally takes up the Hokage hat.
bios.1359: Kabuto Yakushi is a spy and medical ninja who serves Orochimaru before surpassing him. Obsessed with identity, he absorbs Orochimaru's power and uses Edo Tensei in the Great Ninja War. He eventually finds a measure of peace.
bios.1365: Ino Yamanaka is a Yamanaka clan kunoichi who can take control of minds with the Mind Transfer Jutsu. Sakura's friend and rival, she serves as a sensor and medic in the war. Her flower shop gives her a gentle side.
bios.1373: Yamato is a Wood Release user cloned from Hashirama's cells by Orochimaru. He joins Team 7 as a temporary captain to restrain Naruto's Nine-Tails. His steady presence mends the team's bond.
bios.1397: Kurenai Yuhi is Konoha's genjutsu expert and the leader of Team 8. She later raises her daughter Mirai alone after Asuma's death. Her illusions are subtle and deadly.
bios.1425: Black Zetsu is the dark half of the White Zetsu army, born from Kaguya's will. He manipulates Madara, Obito and the Akatsuki to revive his mother. His plan ends when Team 7 seals Kaguya.

konohagakure.blurb: The Village Hidden in the Leaves, founded by Hashirama Senju and Madara Uchiha. Its shinobi carry the Will of Fire, the belief that love for the village is what makes a ninja strong.

sunagakure.blurb: The Village Hidden in the Sand, built in a harsh desert. Its ninja are known for puppetry, wind and magnet release, and have rebuilt a friendly alliance with Konoha.

kirigakure.blurb: The Village Hidden in the Mist, once called the Bloody Mist for its brutal graduation exam. Its swordsmen and water-style masters grew into a new, peaceful era under Mei Terumi.

kumogakure.blurb: The Village Hidden in the Clouds, high in the mountains. A land of lightning release masters, powerful jinchuriki and the fearsome Raikage.

iwagakure.blurb: The Village Hidden in the Rocks, a stern mountain fortress of earth-style ninja. Its Tsuchikage Onoki wields the rare Dust Release.

amegakure.blurb: The Village Hidden in the Rain, a city of towers lashed by endless rainfall. The birthplace of the Akatsuki and the orphan trio of Nagato, Yahiko and Konan.

otogakure.blurb: The Village Hidden in the Sound, created by Orochimaru as a base for experimentation. Its shinobi use sound-based jutsu and curse seals.

kusagakure.blurb: The Village Hidden in the Grass, a small village that turned its attention to secret techniques after surviving the world wars.

takigakure.blurb: The Village Hidden in the Waterfall, home of the Seven-Tails host and a sacred spring. A small land with legends of tailed beasts.

yugakure.blurb: The Village Hidden in the Hot Springs, famous for its resort and the vessel for its guardian monks.

hoshigakure.blurb: The Village Hidden in the Stars, remembered through the Aegis of the Stars and a famous meteorite.

uzushiogakure.blurb: The Village Hidden in the Eddies, homeland of the Uzumaki clan and master sealing arts. Destroyed in a great war but never forgotten.

yukigakure.blurb: The Village Hidden in the Snow, a frozen land at the world's north with its own princess and stories.

mount myōboku.blurb: The home of the summoning toads and the place where Sage Mode is mastered. Naruto, Jiraiya and Minato all trained here.

clans.uchiha: The Uchiha clan are the wielders of the Sharingan, a family of fire-style prodigies tied to Konoha's founding and its darkest tragedies.
clans.hyūga: The Hyuga clan possess the Byakugan, a dojutsu with nearly 360 degrees of vision, and the Gentle Fist taijutsu that attacks the chakra system.
clans.uzumaki: The Uzumaki clan from Uzushiogakure are known for sealing arts, enormous vitality and long life. Their red hair is their hallmark.
clans.senju: The Senju clan founded Konoha alongside the Uchiha. They are known for their incredible life force and the First Hokage's Wood Release.
clans.nara: The Nara clan are Konoha strategists who control shadows with their Shadow Possession Jutsu and keep a herd of deer.
clans.akimichi: The Akimichi clan convert calories into chakra, enlarging their bodies and fighting with their Expansion and Butterfly Modes.
clans.yamanaka: The Yamanaka clan are masters of mind techniques, from telepathy to mind transfer, and run a flower shop on the side.
clans.aburame: The Aburame clan hosts colonies of kikaichu insects inside their bodies and uses them to track, drain chakra and fight.
clans.inuzuka: The Inuzuka clan fight alongside their ninken partners and use their incredible sense of smell to track enemies.
clans.sarutobi: The Sarutobi clan produced the Third Hokage and several of Konoha's elite guardians.
clans.hatake: The Hatake clan of Konoha were once renowned for the White Chakra Sabre; Kakashi Hatake is its best known member.

kekkeiGenkai.sharingan: The Uchiha's copy wheel eye. It sees through illusions and movements, copies jutsu and can cast genjutsu.
kekkeiGenkai.mangekyō sharingan: An evolved Sharingan unlocked through great loss. Each user gains unique abilities such as Amaterasu, Tsukuyomi and Kamui.
kekkeiGenkai.eternal mangekyō sharingan: Created by transplanting the Mangekyo of a sibling, it frees the user from vision loss and strengthens the technique.
kekkeiGenkai.byakugan: The Hyuga's white eye gives nearly 360 degrees vision, sees chakra pathways and X-rays through objects.
kekkeiGenkai.rinnegan: The legendary eyes of the Sage of Six Paths, granting power over life and death, gravity and the Six Paths.
kekkeiGenkai.tenseigan: A dojutsu awakened by an Otsutsuki-blooded Byakugan user, able to use the Chakra Mode and Truth-Seeking Orbs.
kekkeiGenkai.wood release: Hashirama Senju's ability combining earth and water chakra to grow trees and tame tailed beasts.
kekkeiGenkai.lava release: A combination of fire and earth releases to produce molten rock.
kekkeiGenkai.boil release: Fire and water release combined into acidic mist that dissolves its targets.
kekkeiGenkai.ice release: A combination of water and wind that freezes opponents and creates mirrors of ice.
kekkeiGenkai.magnet release: A union of earth and wind that controls iron sand and gold dust.
kekkeiGenkai.crystal release: A mixture of earth and fire that produces solid crystal constructs.
kekkeiGenkai.explosion release: A mixture of earth and lightning that produces explosive detonations.
kekkeiGenkai.dark release: A rare nature capable of absorbing lightning and fire to produce a vacuum of darkness.
kekkeiGenkai.storm release: Water and lightning mixed to create powerful storms.
kekkeiGenkai.scorch release: Wind and fire which burn with intense heat to scorch enemies.
kekkeiGenkai.shikotsumyaku: The Kaguya clan's Dead Bone Pulse which allows them to manipulate their own skeleton.
kekkeiGenkai.steel release: A combination of fire, earth and wind that manipulates metal.
kekkeiGenkai.mud release: A water and earth combination for turning ground into mud.
kekkeiGenkai.swift release: A speed-based lightning combination which increases the user's speed beyond what the eye can follow.
kekkeiGenkai.typhoon release: Wind and water combined into a strong typhoon.
kekkeiGenkai.jōgan: The Hyuga's rare dojutsu able to see the boundaries of the world and the cosmos.
kekkeiGenkai.ketsuryūgan: Blood and Dragon eye with Mongolian roots, a legendary dojutsu.
kekkeiGenkai.senrigan: The Thousand Mile Eye with a far-reaching range of vision.

Fire Release.blurb: Passion turned to flame. Fire jutsu are loud, fast and the signature of the Uchiha.

Wind Release.blurb: Cutting gales that sharpen blades and amplify other natures. Naruto's Rasenshuriken lives here.

Lightning Release.blurb: Chakra converted to piercing electricity. Chidori and the Raikage's armour come from this nature.

Earth Release.blurb: Walls, pits and stone. A defensive nature favoured by Iwagakure.

Water Release.blurb: Flexible torrents drawn from the air itself, popular with the Mist swordsmen.

Yin Release.blurb: The power of imagination made real. Used for genjutsu and creating life.

Yang Release.blurb: The power of physical vitality. Gives form to the spirit.

Yin–Yang Release.blurb: Both halves combined. The foundation of the Six Paths technique.
